summary: Built the round-4 saved-player UX pass: the loader now lives in a right sidebar, starts collapsed, expands via a Korean toggle, renders saved players as compact one-line full-row selectors, and keeps the existing save/load, candidate, preference, and swap flows intact without reintroducing numeric score UI.
completed_work: Refactored the app shell in `src/lib/render.js` so the top area is a two-column workspace with the saved-player loader separated into a sidebar and the preview/result panels left in the main flow below.
Added `savedPanelExpanded` state and wiring in `src/main.js`, defaulting to collapsed and keeping expand/collapse independent from roster, candidate, and editor state.

Rebuilt the saved-player panel markup and styling into a compact row-based list with row-wide selection hit areas, isolated delete buttons, capped-height scrolling, and Korean collapsed/expanded helper copy.
Kept exact-10 load gating, saved-player count sync, canonical TSV reload, and result reset behavior intact while preserving the existing optimizer ordering and hidden-score UI.

Extended regression coverage in `test/appFlow.test.js` and `test/responsiveLayout.test.js` for collapsed-by-default behavior, row click selection, delete isolation, load reset behavior, sidebar layout classes, and scroll/compact-row styling hooks.

Updated `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` to describe the sidebar workflow, default collapsed state, one-line saved-player rows, verification commands run, and the non-blocking browser/mobile verification gap for this round.

verification.result: Passed all 8 test files, including the updated app-flow and responsive layout coverage.
Succeeded and regenerated the static `dist/` bundle.

known_gaps: `npm run test:browser` was not run in this environment, so real browser/mobile smoke evidence is still absent. The current round spec treats that as non-blocking.
handoff_notes: `dist/src/*` was refreshed by the verified build and now includes the sidebar/collapse changes.
The worktree already showed unrelated modifications in `.harness/spec.md` and `.harness/plan.json`; they were left as-is.
